description: Architecture review guidelines for tasks with system-wide impact.
review_triggers: New microservice or service boundary change
Data pipeline or event-driven architecture changes
Message queue or caching layer changes

required_review_artifacts.description: Show how the change fits in the broader system
Show data in/out, storage, and transformations
Confirm existing consumers are not broken
Define how to revert if the change causes issues
Expected latency, throughput, and resource impact
New attack surface, data exposure, or privilege changes
